title: feat: add tencent/hy3 via OpenRouter with AtlasCloud fallback
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15139

## Summary
- Adds `tencent/hy3` as a new paid-only text model (no aliases), routed through OpenRouter, pinned to the `gmicloud/bf16` endpoint
- Pricing: $0.14/M input, $0.58/M output, $0.035/M cache read — verified live against OpenRouter's `/api/v1/models/tencent/hy3/endpoints`
- Context 262,144, max output 235,929 (also verified live)
- Fallback: OpenRouter `atlas-cloud/fp8` tag, a different provider

## Route research
Hy3 is served through **six** OpenRouter endpoints. Two were deliberately passed over:
- **Tencent (direct)** — bills a **time-of-day rate**: $0.132/$0.528 per M (00:00–16:00 UTC) vs $0.0825/$0.33 per M (16:00–00:00 UTC). The registry's cost schema has no concept of time-varying rates, so pinning here would mean either over- or under-billing depending on time of day.
- **DeepInfra** — cheapest flat rate, but reporting **35.6% uptime over the last 5 minutes** (82.9% over 30 min) at research time — not safe to route to.

Of the remaining four (GMICloud, Novita, Phala, AtlasCloud), **GMICloud** was chosen as primary: flat pricing, bf16 quantization (best precision of the non-degraded options), 100%/100%/99.96% uptime. **AtlasCloud** is the fallback: a different provider, and the most reliable of all six endpoints (100%/100%/99.99% uptime), at a real ~40% higher cost recorded on its own route entry rather than absorbed into the primary quote.

## Contract (confirmed)
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Canonical name | `tencent/hy3` |
| Aliases | none |
| Registry provider | `openrouter` |
| Primary route | OpenRouter `gmicloud/bf16` tag |
| Fallback | OpenRouter `atlas-cloud/fp8` tag |
| Pollinations GPU | no |

## Notes
- Reasoning is **on by default** (`default_effort: "high"`) per OpenRouter's model metadata, but not mandatory — `"none"` is an explicitly supported effort value, so no reasoning-effort transform is needed (unlike models that reject `"none"`)
